title: Paychex Flex - All-in-one payroll, benefits, and HR for small businesses
clean_text: Paychex Flex combines payroll processing with business insurance, benefits enrollment, workers' comp, and HR administration in one cloud-based dashboard with desktop and mobile access. Its small business solutions are specifically tailored to companies with 1-19 employees, helping them save time, cut costs, and stay compliant, while also serving remote teams wanting an all-in-one payroll/benefits/HR-compliance solution. All packages include paperless, mobile-friendly onboarding and access to "Fortune 500-level" employee benefits plus financial wellness tools including short-term loans. Paychex completed a $4.1 billion acquisition of HCM competitor Paycor in April 2025.
